description: Took the share, and kept a second bowl off the sheet.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Named himself and Holywell, brought the figure and the clause, and asked you to keep his father from the curse.
name: Cuthbert Burbage

description: Said the house stood, and brought no other news.
name: James Burbage

description: Named eight-and-twenty, refused extras, and shut the book.
name: John Heminges

description: Refused an average, and wanted supper.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Claimed the noise, took the same share, and left.
name: Will Kemp

description: Asked the play's worth, offered a king, and agreed nothing.
name: William Shakespeare
